name: SimpleGraph.Walk.IsPath
type: {V : Type u} → {G : SimpleGraph V} → {u v : V} → G.Walk u v → Prop
provides: An undirected skeleton walk has no repeated vertices, with the inherited no-repeated-edge property; orientation and collider conditions are additional.
